headline: Public hearings on 92 Adams Street parking area appeal and 146 East Avenue lot subdivision for a new single-family residence.
summary: The board will hold public hearings on an appeal of an administrative denial at 92 Adams Street and a proposed subdivision at 146 East Avenue to allow construction of a new single-family residence while keeping an existing triplex.
items: ZAP-26-13; 92 Adams Street (RM, Ward 6) 92 Adams Realty, LLC / Marcia Hemley - Appeal of administrative denial for 15-year determination for an unpermitted parking area under ZP-26-338

ZP-26-387; 146 East Avenue (RL, Ward 1) FMB East Avenue, LLC / Taylor Baker - Proposed subdivision of existing residential lot to create a new 55' x 167' residential lot for construction of a new single-family residence; existing triplex to remain
location: 645 Pine Street, Front Conference Room or Remote on Zoom
